reuse_rationale: Unit-only, unchanged platform/API/domain checks in green-tests.txt remain applicable; the final first-claim UI correction has its own Red/Green browser run followed by fresh 39-test post-refactor and 12-case browser smoke. Final typecheck/build include the UI correction. Earlier logs are historical and are not substituted for final runs.

scenarios.prerequisites: Installed dependencies and final production web/API build; no real push credentials
scenarios.actions: Exercise all 12 browser cases: main weather/air/nation/settings/favorites, offline/corrupt snapshots, search/geolocation races, dialogs, first claim, cleanup failure/success, rain/snow and actual two-version worker update
scenarios.expected: All assertions pass, updated caches win, old chunks remain usable, unsaved edits/favorites survive failure and data labels are correct
scenarios.failure: Lost edits/state, stale shell, invalid units/periods, failed route or page error
scenarios.cleanup: Playwright closes browser and loopback server; fixtures use isolated browser contexts and no live external side effects
